spec_basis.STU-RAW-015: a heal/clone spot-removal tool with source-point control ... develop-scoped operations on StudioRawDevelop and reuse the raster retouch primitives of 14.4 where the capability is shared ([STU-DOC-004]); they are not a parallel retouch implementation
spec_basis.STU-RAW-124: A retouch area is a record carrying spot_type (heal or clone), heal_version, feather, opacity, seed, a method (gaussian observed), a source_state (source_set_explicitly observed, versus an engine-chosen source), a target dab-mask list with the same brush geometry as [STU-RAW-121], and the source offset (source_x, source_y, offset_y, centre_x, centre_y, radius) ... Studio's core distraction removal is the on-device inpaint of [STU-RAS-143]. Where an adapter produced a fill, the record MUST carry the adapter identity, the model identity and version, whether it ran locally, the patch variation set, and the digests
spec_basis.STU-RAW-105: PANEL ENABLE FLAGS ARE PART OF THE STATE
spec_basis.STU-RAW-103: INTERCHANGE DECODE AND ENCODE (decode only in this lane)

declared_readings: stage position: whole frame, first post-tile stage (before detail/clarity, local corrections, effects) on the developed scene-linear frame after the crop; mask and source coordinates normalised to that frame; retouch areas before distraction areas (UNVERIFIED vs Lightroom)

domain: each area's windows are divided by the smallest power of two s >= max(1, largest value) and covered pixels multiplied back (exact in binary32 for normal values; tested at +3 EV, values > 1, exact copy); negative values refused unsupported_contribution:retouch_negative_value, non-finite non_finite; pigment's own [0, alpha] clamp of a solved heal value still applies

source offset: target = source translated by (centre - source) in pixels; offset_y, heal_version, method and the retouch-area seed are validated and retained but do not change pixels (one heal algorithm, one feather profile)
target mask: union (screen) of the dab masks; with no dab mask the centre_x/centre_y/radius circle with the area feather; radius = fraction of the shorter side as in local.rs
a source footprint leaving the frame is refused unsupported_contribution:retouch_source_outside_frame
engine-chosen clone areas clone from spot_heal's chosen offset

lrcat field names: CamelCase of the spec fields (SpotType, HealVersion, Feather, Opacity, Seed, Method, SourceState, SourceX, SourceY, OffsetY, CenterX/CentreX, CenterY/CentreY, Radius, Masks{Radius, Flow, Feather, Dabs}); SourceState maps sourceSetExplicitly/source_set_explicitly/engine_chosen only; all UNVERIFIED (D5)
spec_deltas: STU-RAW-015 requires red-eye / pet-eye with pupil size and darken controls but STU-RAW-124 lists no red-eye record fields: red_eye stays refused (UnsupportedContribution("red_eye"))
STU-RAW-124 does not state the stage position in the develop order, the meaning of heal_version values, the meaning of offset_y next to source_y, or the engine-chosen source_state value name
STU-RAW-124 lists source_x and source_y but no source mask list for brush spots; the brush-spot source is read as the target masks translated by (centre - source)
